enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn to the right side. Pull the pillow with the left hand. Adjust the head on the pillow. Keep arms under the blanket. Turn to the left side. Stretch the legs. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the back. Place both hands on the chest. Turn onto the right side again. Move the right arm under the pillow. Remain lying with eyes closed. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Shift the pillow position with the head. Remain lying until morning.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Swing legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the light. Stand in front of the sink. Turn on the tap. Put both hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Put the soap back on the holder. Rub the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Open the toothpaste cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Close the toothpaste cap. Put the tube down on the shelf. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch to start boiling. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl and a plate. Close the cupboard door. Place the bowl and plate on the counter. Pick up an egg. Crack the egg on the edge of the bowl. Pour the egg into the bowl. Repeat with a second egg. Pick up a fork. Beat the eggs with the fork. Place a pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up the bread. Place the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into a cup. Put a tea bag into the cup. Pick up the plate and the cup. Carry them to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs. Pick up the toast from the toaster. Eat the toast. Pick up the cup. Drink the tea. Place the cup on the table. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the light. Pick up the laundry basket from the floor. Carry the basket to the washing machine. Open the washing machine door. Take the clothes out of the basket. Put the clothes into the drum one by one. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Pour fabric softener into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Press the program selection button. Press the start button. Listen to the machine start. Check the drum through the glass door with both hands on the edge. Pick up the empty laundry basket. Place the basket on the shelf. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the light. Pick up the cushions from the sofa. Place the cushions on the chair. Pick up the magazines from the coffee table. Stack the magazines. Place the magazines on the shelf. Pick up the remote control from the table. Place the remote control on the TV stand. Walk to the corner. Pick up the vacuum cleaner. Unwind the power cord. Plug the power cord into the socket. Press the vacuum cleaner power button. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull the vacuum cleaner back. Move the vacuum cleaner under the coffee table. Move the vacuum cleaner along the sofa. Move the vacuum cleaner to the corner. Press the power button to stop the vacuum cleaner. Unplug the power cord. Wind the power cord around the hook. Place the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Pick up the cushions. Place the cushions back on the sofa. Turn off the light. Walk out of the living room.

Walk to the entrance door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk along the path to the street. Walk to the supermarket. Push the supermarket entrance door open. Walk into the store. Pick up a shopping cart by the handle. Push the cart along the aisle. Stop at the vegetable shelf. Pick up tomatoes. Place the tomatoes into the cart. Pick up lettuce. Place the lettuce into the cart. Push the cart to the next aisle. Pick up bread from the shelf. Place the bread into the cart. Pick up milk from the refrigerator shelf. Place the milk into the cart. Pick up eggs from the shelf. Place the eggs into the cart. Push the cart to the meat counter. Pick up a pack of chicken. Place the chicken into the cart. Push the cart to the checkout. Lift the items onto the conveyor belt one by one. Wait at the checkout. Pick up the items. Place the items into the shopping bags. Pick up the bags. Pay at the card terminal. Press the card against the reader. Pick up the receipt. Pick up the bags. Walk to the exit. Push the exit door open. Walk back home. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Place the bags on the kitchen counter.

Stand at the kitchen counter. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lettuce. Take out the tomatoes. Take out the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the cutting board. Turn on the tap. Rinse the lettuce under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the lettuce on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the lettuce into pieces. Slide the lettuce into a bowl. Pick up a tomato. Cut the tomato into slices. Place the tomato slices into the bowl. Place the chicken on the cutting board. Cut the chicken into pieces. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Place the chicken pieces into the pan. Stir the chicken with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the chicken onto a plate. Carry the bowl and the plate to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the salad. Pick up the knife. Cut the chicken. Eat the chicken. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the dishes to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the plates with the sponge. Rinse the plates under the water. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the upper rack. Place the plates into the rack. Push the upper rack in. Pull out the lower rack. Place the bowls into the lower rack. Place the cups into the lower rack. Place the cutlery into the basket. Push the lower rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Open the detergent compartment. Pour detergent into the compartment. Close the detergent compartment. Press the dishwasher power button. Press the start button. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the counter with the sponge. Rinse the sponge under the tap. Turn off the tap. Place the sponge on the holder. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table with the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the light. Walk out of the kitchen.

Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control from the TV stand. Press the power button on the remote control. Point the remote control at the TV. Press the channel button. Press the volume button. Place the remote control on the armrest. Sit on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Pick up the cushion. Place the cushion behind the back. Cross the legs. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button again. Place the remote control on the armrest. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Drink water from the bottle. Close the bottle cap. Place the bottle on the coffee table. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Place the remote control down. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Jogging and exercising in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the sports shoes. Sit on the bed. Put on the sports shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Stand up. Take out the sports jacket. Put on the sports jacket. Zip up the jacket. Walk to the entrance door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk along the street. Start jogging. Jog to the park. Enter the park through the gate. Jog along the path. Stop at the open area. Bend the torso forward. Stretch the arms upward. Stretch the legs one by one. Start jogging again along the path. Increase the pace. Jog around the pond. Slow down to a walk. Stop near the bench. Place both hands on the hips. Breathe. Sit on the bench. Stretch the legs forward. Stand up. Walk out of the park. Walk back home along the street. Open the entrance door. Step inside. Close the door.

Walk to Bedroom 1. Take off the sports jacket. Place the jacket on the bed. Take off the sports shoes. Place the shoes beside the bed. Take off the socks. Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the light. Step into the shower area. Open the shower glass door. Turn on the water tap. Adjust the water temperature knob. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Put the soap back on the holder. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the water tap. Open the shower glass door. Step out. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the body with the towel. Wipe the hair with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the bathrobe. Put on the bathrobe. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Pick up the remote control from the desk. Press the power button. Point the remote control at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote control on the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the legs. Place the pillow behind the head. Turn the head toward the TV. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Place the remote control on the bed. Turn to the right side. Pull the blanket up. Turn to the back. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone screen. Scroll the phone screen with the finger. Place the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Place the remote control on the bedside table. Sit up on the bed.

Stand up from the bed. Walk to the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Slide the vegetables into a bowl. Place the chicken on the cutting board. Cut the chicken into pieces. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Place the chicken pieces into the pan. Stir the chicken with a spatula. Add the vegetables into the pan. Stir the mixture with the spatula. Pour water into the pan. Place the lid on the pan. Press the timer button on the induction cooker. Open the cupboard door. Take out a plate. Close the cupboard door. Place the plate on the counter. Press the induction cooker power button to turn it off. Remove the lid. Slide the food onto the plate. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Place the plate on the table.

Pull out the chair. Sit on the chair. Pick up the fork. Pick up the knife. Cut the chicken with the knife. Lift the chicken with the fork. Eat the chicken. Cut the vegetables with the knife. Lift the vegetables with the fork. Eat the vegetables. Place the knife on the plate. Place the fork on the plate. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Place the glass on the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the remaining vegetables. Pick up the plate. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the glass. Carry the glass to the sink. Place the plate and glass in the sink. Pick up the napkin. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Place the napkin on the table. Push the chair back under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing video games
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the light. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Point the remote control at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote control on the couch. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the game console controller from the coffee table. Press the power button on the console. Press the controller button. Watch the TV screen. Move the joystick with the left thumb. Press the action button with the right thumb. Lean forward toward the TV. Press the joystick to the left. Press the action button repeatedly. Place the controller on the lap. Pick up the glass of water from the coffee table. Drink water. Place the glass back on the coffee table. Pick up the controller. Press the pause button. Place the controller on the coffee table. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Place the remote control on the couch. Pick up the controller. Press the resume button. Move the joystick. Press the action button. Press the console power button. Place the controller on the coffee table. Stand up. Press the TV power button on the remote control. Turn off the light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing up and skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the light. Stand in front of the sink. Turn on the tap. Put the hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Put the soap back on the holder. Rub the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the bottle of cleanser. Open the cap. Squeeze cleanser onto the palm. Close the cap. Apply the cleanser to the face with the fingers. Turn on the tap. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the tube of cream. Open the cap. Squeeze cream onto the fingertip. Close the cap. Apply the cream to the face with the fingers. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using phone and computer while winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit on the bed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone screen. Swipe the phone screen with the finger. Type a message on the phone keyboard. Press the send button. Place the phone on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit on the chair. Press the computer power button. Place both hands on the keyboard. Type on the keyboard. Move the mouse with the right hand. Click the mouse button. Look at the monitor. Type on the keyboard again. Move the mouse. Click the mouse button. Place both hands on the lap. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Press the computer power button to shut it down. Pick up the phone from the bed. Sit on the bed. Press the phone screen. Scroll the phone screen with the finger. Press the phone lock button. Place the phone on the bedside table. Turn off the desk lamp. Turn off the light. Lie down on the bed.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Close eyes. Turn to the right side. Move the left arm under the pillow. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn to the left side. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Turn onto the back. Place both arms on the blanket. Turn to the right side again. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Remain lying with eyes closed. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow with the head. Keep both arms under the blanket. Remain lying in the dark room until sleep.
